product_launches.description: SelfDrive Mobility launched SelfDrive Intelligence Assistant (SIA), a multilingual conversational AI car rental reservation engine supporting 40+ languages with instant booking and secure payments, now live on its website and mobile apps.

overview_description.description: SelfDrive.ae is a Smart Mobility Transportation Network Company,  Selfdrive is one of the fastest growing all technology platform that seamlessly integrates car manufactures and dealer network with Subscription based tech for on demand monthly rentals and Lease to Own business models in the region. It offers On Demand Car Ownership experience with Zero Liabilities. SelfDrive.ae brings in industry leading expertise in car rentals, leasing and e-commerce. It’s the reagions 1st platform to offer 1 day to 36-month leasing and Car Subscription rentals in the region, Serving B2B, B2C and B2G customers. It has served more the 6000+ clients from 90 different nationalities and has received over 200K+ confirmed days of reservation on its platform. Selfdrive.ae partners with Car manufacturers, Dealer Networks and Leasing companies to offer a complete range of cars starting from economy, Mid Size Saloons, Compact SUVs, MUVs and 4x4 SUVs to serve its customers. Selfdrive.ae platform currently operates a fleet of 600 cars on road and intents to reach 1000 cars by end of 2019. The company also has plans to add 3000 cars exclusively on the Micro lease platform making it one of the fastest growing  car subscription Company in the region with plans to expand its services across GCC.

about_short_description.short_description: SelfDrive.ae is a Smart Mobility Transportation Network Company.

product.name: Daily/Weekly Car Rental
product.description: Short-term self-drive vehicle rentals for daily or weekly use, serving tourists, business travelers, and residents across the UAE.

product.name: Monthly Car Rental & Car Subscription
product.description: Flexible month-to-month vehicle rentals and subscriptions for residents, visitors, and businesses that need extended vehicle access without ownership.

product.name: Car Lease UAE
product.description: Long-term leasing of new sedans, SUVs, and electric vehicles with fixed plans that include maintenance, insurance, registration, and roadside support.

product.name: Corporate Subscription
product.description: Business-focused vehicle subscription and leasing services for companies requiring flexible transportation capacity and managed vehicle access.

product.name: Airport Car Rental
product.description: Vehicle rental with airport pickup or delivery to terminals at airports in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and other supported locations.

product.name: Luxury & Exotic Car Rental
product.description: Rental of premium and luxury vehicles, including BMW, Mercedes, Range Rover, and other high-end models for events, business travel, and premium transportation.
